'''Mas Avaho''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he informed [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]s about a shipment of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] machines that were delivered for a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. However, he was not sure what the machines were, but they were important enough for the Sith Lord to send his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] to oversee the shipment. The Republic operatives then attacked the [[Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse]].<ref name="TOR:Inspection" />
